name: dualmac
title: DualMac
description: Zero-permission Virtual DualSense bridge, MacBook Trackpad + Keyboard GTA 6 Smart Pack, and WAN stream optimizer for PS5 Remote Play on macOS
author: yyamandevrim

preferences.name: projectDir
preferences.title: DualMac Directory (Optional)
preferences.description: Leave empty if installed via `make install` (~/.local/bin/dualmac), or pick your cloned dualmac folder

preferences.name: homeHost
preferences.title: Home PS5 / WAN Probe Host
preferences.description: Optional home IP or DDNS hostname for latency/jitter probing (default: 1.1.1.1)

preferences.name: privilegedByDefault
preferences.title: Pause Wi-Fi AWDL by Default
preferences.label: Use Touch ID / Admin prompt to pause awdl0/llw0 and boost kernel UDP buffers (fixes 30-100ms Wi-Fi lag spikes)

commands.name: play-gta6
commands.title: Play GTA 6 (DualMac)
commands.description: Choose Sony Remote Play or chiaki-ng preset, view MacBook Trackpad controls, and launch

commands.name: quick-play
commands.title: Quick Play GTA 6
commands.description: Instantly launch Official PS Remote Play with Virtual DualSense & GTA 6 Smart Pack

commands.name: network-doctor
commands.title: DualMac Network Doctor
commands.description: Inspect WAN ping, jitter, packet loss, PSN firewall reachability, and macOS AWDL Wi-Fi spikes

commands.name: restore-system
commands.title: DualMac Restore System
commands.description: Restore awdl0/llw0, DNS/VPN, kernel UDP buffers, and chiaki-ng preferences after a session
